description: This file defines a React component named 'Review' that displays a list of reviews, handles loading states, pagination, and no-results scenarios. It connects to Redux for state management and imports various subcomponents for rendering different parts of the review dashboard.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing reviews, including pagination and loading states.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that fetches reviews when the component is mounted.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the review dashboard, including loading indicator, pagination, review list, and no reviews message.
